title: read + listing endpoints
instruction: Add `GET /api/stipends` returning all stipends. Add `GET /api/awards` (authenticated with `Authorization: Token <token>`) returning the authenticated user's awards, newest first, with an optional `?status=active|rescinded` query filter.

title: budget adjustment
instruction: Add `POST /api/stipends/{stipendId}/adjust-budget` accepting `{ "deltaCents": <integer> }` that increases or decreases the stipend's `budgetCents` and returns the updated stipend. Reject with 409 if the new budget would be below the amount already awarded to active awards. Budget/limit checks and summaries use the new budget.

title: audit log
instruction: Add an append-only audit log recording every award creation and every rescission, exposed via `GET /api/stipends/{stipendId}/audit` returning `{ "type": "award_created"|"award_rescinded", "awardId": string, "userId": string, "at": ISO-8601 }` in chronological order.

title: reporting + award versioning
instruction: Add `GET /api/stipends/{stipendId}/report` returning `{ "perUser": [{ "userId": string, "activeAwardCount": int, "awardedCents": int }], "totalActiveAwards": int, "totalAwardedCents": int }`. Add a `version` integer to every award that starts at 1 and increments on each mutation (rescind increments it).
